messages:
elaine: starting canary for release v2.14.0 now in the 02:00-04:00 change window. routing=1% -> planned ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m. enabling feature flag `new-ranking` for canary cohort. deploy-bot will post status updates. pls 🚨 watch telemetry

deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v2.14.0 (sha: ab12cd3). Canary cohort: 1% traffic -> new-ranking=on for cohort A. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14.0 | CI: green | smoke: running

samir: saw a small uptick in 5xx from canary at ~5m in. tail looks like rate_limiter hits on the routing service. snippet from logs: ```rate_limiter: quota_exceeded count=132 window=60s```

devops-jen: could be burst + token bucket tuning. can we hold ramp at 1% and increase per-node rate limit by 20% before moving to 5%? Otherwise pin back to stable route.

matthew: +1 hold. if rate limit change is risky, prefer slow ramp. also propose enabling fallback route to v2.13.5 for errors > 0.5% for 2m.

elaine: agree. holding ramp. setting new ramp plan: 1% -> 2% after rate-limit bump -> 5% only if errors <0.3% for 5m. I'll pin canary cohort to v2.13.5 for failover.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused at 1%. Actions taken: 1) toggled runtime holdpoint 2) set `canary_hold=true` 3) created rollback runbook https://internal.ops/runbooks/v2.14.0-rollout 

oncall-bot: Alert: canary error_budget crossed threshold (threshold=0.5%) — current error_rate=0.9% — paging: samir, devops-jen

samir: rolling plan: 1) attempt rate-limiter bump (safe param +20%) via infra API 2) if error_rate does not drop below 0.5% within 5m -> set `new-ranking` to 0% -> rollback traffic to v2.13.5 for cohorts A,B -> execute smoke tests.

devops-jen: rate-limit bump applied to canary nodes. watch logs for 2m. smoke curl to validate routing after rollback if needed: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/flags/new-ranking -d '{"percentage":0}'```

elaine: confirming I'll flip flag to 0% if no improvement in 5m. posting release notes for visibility: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14.0/notes. Adding a short blurb to the release: "canary paused due to rate-limiter signals; investigating"

matthew: if we end up toggling the flag off, let's also capture an eval prompt set for the behaviour regression check so we can compare post-rollback quality quickly.

samir: agreed. i'll run evals against the canary prompt set. target: <10min for initial signal.

elaine: thanks all. holding here — keep pings in this thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: after rate-limit bump, error_rate -> 0.28% (5m avg). Canary ramp allowed to 5% per new plan. Continuing monitor.
